budget: three spec candidates per rendered diagram

attempts.label: canvas-c1
attempts.change: first canvas: d1 (pair) lr, d2 (dispatch) lr, d3 (storage+daemon) tb; full source labels
attempts.result: rejected: 1 label skipped + 1 ambiguous owner (d1:e0 "task input + control RPCs"), canvas widened to 202 by a 163-char description
attempts.why: the pair's two labels land in one rank gap in lr and share an apparent owner; the long description widened the canvas beyond the drawings

attempts.label: canvas-c2
attempts.change: d1 switched to tb, d3 switched to lr, descriptions shortened
attempts.result: rejected: labels 6/8, 2 skipped (both d1 labels), 0 ambiguous
attempts.why: a tb 2-node diagram is only ~15 cells wide, and a 25-char label needs a clear horizontal span inside the extent (clear() rejects lo<1 or lo+len>extent.0-1), so both pair labels were dropped

attempts.label: canvas-c3
attempts.change: d1 back to lr with minlen:2 on worker -> runtime, so the layout reserves the pair's own label rank
attempts.result: clean on every check line: labels 8/8 placed, 0 leader-ticked, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous; near-misses 0; crossings 0; no warnings
attempts.why: shipped (with the text-only revision below): the reserved label rank gives the long seam label structural ownership instead of a guessed neighbour distance

final_revision.label: canvas-c3-final
final_revision.change: descriptions only: shortened to 105 characters each
final_revision.why: a description wider than the widest drawing sets the canvas extent but is drawn at its section's x offset, so a longer line was cut off at the canvas edge (defect recorded in generation.json); no layout, route or label changed
